_meta.title: Session 45 — Qwen-VLA paper (Alibaba Qwen Team, arxiv 2605.30280, May 28 2026): unified VLA for tasks/environments/embodiments
_meta.context: Two user-provided links = same release. qwen.ai/blog?id=qwenvla is JS-rendered shell; arxiv 2605.30280 is the actual source. Paper introduces Qwen-VLA (Qwen3.5-4B backbone + DiT flow-matching action decoder), 4-stage training (T2A pre-training → CPT → SFT → RL on SimplerEnv). 4 NEW Qwen-VLA model variants: Base (CPT), Instruct (SFT+RL), ALOHA w/o pretrain, ALOHA w/ pretrain. NEW benchmark introduced: SimplerEnv-OOD (6 OOD tasks on WidowX). DOMINO is a NEW eval-only dataset cited (Qwen-VLA-Instruct 26.6 zero-shot SR beats every fine-tuned baseline). KEY SOTAs: RoboTwin-Hard 87.2 (vs prior best ABot-M0 85.0), Simpler-WidowX 73.7 (vs StarVLA-OFT 64.6, GR00T N1.6 63.2), SimplerEnv-OOD 32.0 (vs π0.5 12.6 — 2.5x gap), ALOHA real-world in-domain 83.6 + OOD 76.9 (vs π0.5 71.6/41.5). Navigation: R2R 57.5 + RxR 59.6 SR (beats StreamVLN). 2 frontier comparison models registered (ABot-M0, StarVLA-OFT); other comparisons (Being-H0.5, RDT-1B, InternVLA-M1, VLA-Adapter, PUMA, NaVid/Uni-NaVid/NaVILA/StreamVLN) skipped per scope.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Triples extracted by agent from Tables in arxiv 2605.30280v1. NEW benches: robotwin_easy/hard split (distinct from existing robotwin2 which is 0-1 aggregate), simpler_widowx (WidowX-specific subset of SimplerEnv, distinct from existing simpler_env_avg), robocasa_gr1 (RoboCasa-GR1 specific eval, distinct from existing robocasa/robocasa365), simplerenv_ood (NEW 6-OOD tasks introduced by paper), domino_sr (NEW DOMINO Success Rate), aloha_real_in_domain (real-world ALOHA hardware eval, distinct from existing aloha_4task_avg simulated), r2r_val_unseen_sr + rxr_val_unseen_sr (vision-language navigation). LIBERO aggregate skipped (existing per-suite libero_spatial/object/goal/long covers more granular). EXCLUDED comparison models: Being-H0.5, RDT-1B, InternVLA-M1, VLA-Adapter, PUMA, OpenVLA-OFT (FT), π0-FAST (existing), LingBot-VA (existing), NaVid/Uni-NaVid/NaVILA/StreamVLN — too many; only 2 frontier comparisons (ABot-M0, StarVLA-OFT) registered.

models.name: Qwen-VLA-Base
models._note: Generalist VLA after Continued Pre-Training. Qwen3.5-4B backbone + DiT flow-matching action decoder. arxiv 2605.30280.

models.name: Qwen-VLA-Instruct
models._note: After multi-task SFT + RL on SimplerEnv. RoboTwin-Hard 87.2 SOTA, SimplerEnv-OOD 32.0 (2.5x π0.5), DOMINO zero-shot SR 26.6 SOTA (beats every fine-tuned baseline).
